SELECT NHMT.APKIHONCD ,NHMT.SHOPCD ,NHMT.KATASIKI ,NHMT.KSHNSYSTMYMD ,NHMT.KSHNSYSTMJIKAN ,NHMT.NYUSHUKKODNPYNO ,NHMT.NYUSHUKKODNPYMEISAINO ,NHMT.NYUSHUKKOKBN ,NHMT.LCTGRYCD ,NHMT.MCTGRYCD ,NHMT.SCTGRYCD ,NHMT.SHNCD ,NHMT.SURYO ,NHMT.UNT ,NHMT.KIN ,NHMT.MEISAIBIKO ,SHMV.SHNAPKIHONCD ,CASE WHEN SHMV.SHNNMKIRIKAEDD <= NHTT.NYUSHUKKODD THEN SHMV.SHINSHNNMRYAKUSHO ELSE SHMV.GENZSHNNMRYAKUSHO END SHNNMRYAKUSHO ,CASE WHEN SHMV.HYOJUNPRICEKIRIKAEDD <= NHTT.NYUSHUKKODD THEN SHMV.SHINPRICEKBN ELSE SHMV.GENZPRICEKBN END PRICEKBN ,SHMV.HYOJUNPRICEKIRIKAEDD ,SHMV.GENZHYOJUNPRICE ,SHMV.SHINHYOJUNPRICE ,SHMV.GENZMOCHIKAERIPRICE ,SHMV.SHINMOCHIKAERIPRICE ,SHMV.OPNPRICEKIRIKAEDD ,SHMV.GENZOPNPRICE ,SHMV.SHINOPNPRICE ,SHMV.GENZOPNMOCHIKAERIPRICE ,SHMV.SHINOPNMOCHIKAERIPRICE ,SHMV.HANSOKUKBN ,SHMV.HANSOKUSTRTDD ,SHMV.HANSOKUSHRYDD ,SHMV.HANSOKUDLVRYPRICE ,SHMV.HANSOKUMOCHIKAERIPRICE ,SHMV.ZAIKOUNT ,SHMV.IRO ,SHMV.SZNM SZ ,SHMV.URITRTSKITANINM URITRTSKITANI ,SHMV.URIIRISU ,SHMV.URITANINM URITANI ,SHMV.ZAIKOKANRITRGTFLG AS ZAIKOKANRITRGTFLGSHMV ,SHOPM.ZAIKOKANRIKBN AS ZAIKOKANRIKBNSHOPM ,SHMV.SIIRETRTSKITANINM SIIRETRTSKITANI ,SHMV.SIIREIRISU ,SHMV.SIIRETANINM SIIRETANI ,SHMV.TAXSETTEIKBN ,SHMV.TAXKBN ,SHMV.ZAIKOARAMUSURYO ,SHMV.TRTSKIKBN ,NHMT.SURYO * SHMV.SIIREIRISU SIIRESOKAZU ,((NHMT.SURYO * SHMV.SIIREIRISU) * SHMV.URIIRISU) URISOKAZU
FROM S11T004T NHMT INNER JOIN S11T003T NHTT ON(NHTT.APKIHONCD = NHMT.APKIHONCD AND NHTT.SHOPCD = NHMT.SHOPCD AND NHTT.NYUSHUKKODNPYNO = NHMT.NYUSHUKKODNPYNO AND NHTT.NYUSHUKKOKBN = NHMT.NYUSHUKKOKBN ) LEFT OUTER JOIN S02V001T SHMV ON(SHMV.APKIHONCD = NHMT.APKIHONCD AND SHMV.SHOPCD = NHMT.SHOPCD AND SHMV.SHNCD = NHMT.SHNCD AND SHMV.SHOPYUKOKBN = '1' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN S02M046T SHOPM ON(SHOPM.APKIHONCD= SHMV.APKIHONCD AND SHOPM.SHOPCD = SHMV.SHOPCD ) WHERE NHMT.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NHMT.SHOPCD = #{shopcd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NHMT.NYUSHUKKODNPYNO = #{nyushukkodnpyno, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND NHMT.NYUSHUKKOKBN = '2'
AND NHMT.NYUSHUKKOKBN = '1'
AND ROWNUM <= #{rownum} + 1 ORDER BY NHMT.NYUSHUKKODNPYNO , NHMT.NYUSHUKKODNPYMEISAINO

SELECT NSJT.NYUSHUKKODD ,NSMT.NYUSHUKKODNPYMEISAIEDANO ,NSJT.SHUKKOSAKISOKOCD ,NSJT.DNPYBIKO ,SOKM.SOKOKBN ,SOKM.YUBINNO ,SOKM.ADRSN1 ,SOKM.ADRSN2 ,SOKM.ADRSN3 ,SOKM.RENRAKUSAKINON1 ,SOKM.RENRAKUSAKINON2 ,SOKM.SOKONMN1 ,SOKM.SOKONMN2 ,SHMV.SHNNMKIRIKAEDD ,SHMV.GENZSHNNM ,SHMV.SHINSHNNM ,SHMV.SIIRETRTSKITANINM ,NSMT.SURYO ,NSMT.UNT ,NSMT.MEISAIBIKO FROM S11T003T NSJT --入出庫実績テーブル LEFT OUTER JOIN S02M041T SOKM --倉庫マスタ ON SOKM.APKIHONCD = NSJT.APKIHONCD AND SOKM.SHOPCD = NSJT.SHOPCD AND SOKM.SOKOCD = NSJT.SHUKKOSAKISOKOCD INNER JOIN S11T004T NSMT --入出庫実績明細テーブル ON NSJT.APKIHONCD = NSMT.APKIHONCD AND NSJT.SHOPCD = NSMT.SHOPCD AND NSJT.NYUSHUKKODNPYNO = NSMT.NYUSHUKKODNPYNO AND NSJT.NYUSHUKKOKBN = NSMT.NYUSHUKKOKBN LEFT OUTER JOIN S02V001T SHMV --商品マスタビュー ON SHMV.APKIHONCD = NSMT.APKIHONCD AND SHMV.SHOPCD = NSMT.SHOPCD AND SHMV.SHNCD = NSMT.SHNCD WHERE NSJT.NYUSHUKKOKBN = '1' AND NSJT.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NSJT.SHOPCD = #{shopcd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NSJT.NYUSHUKKODNPYNO = #{nyushukkodnpyno, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
